title: 第十五章 小乞丐上第十六章 小乞丐下
content_zh:
颜铁龙看着眼前这位执着让自己加入他们雇佣兵团的峰雷狂熊，不想让这位看上去粗鲁，但是属于好人大汉遭遇不测，就再一次确定的问道：“峰雷狂熊，你们雇佣兵团真的要去做这个高危险任务？”。
“恩，这一次是难得的机会，只要我们比那些雇佣兵团先弄到一二斤紫水晶蜂蜜，那么我们雇佣兵团规模就能扩大，我不打算放弃！”峰雷狂熊承认在危险也要去收集紫水晶蜂蜜。
“既然要去收集紫水晶蜂蜜，那么你们雇佣兵团成员本每人最好携带一些硫磺，说不定到时候能保你们一条小命，对了，还有千万不要碰毒晶蜜蜂女王，要是意外的碰到的话就以最快的速度跑到安全区，这几条就当你给我买这一杯麦酒钱。”颜铁龙善意的提醒完就拿起剩下一半麦酒的酒杯一口气饮尽，然后起身离开。
这一次颜铁龙离开，峰雷狂熊没有在阻拦，他正在考虑颜铁龙刚刚提供的信息。
“团长，刚刚那位不是你一直想要招募的颜铁龙阁下，你怎么让他走了？”山蛮雇佣兵团几名成员跟颜铁龙相交而过，当时那些蛮山雇佣兵团成员停下来回头看着颜铁龙离开的身影，然后他们快速来到正在发呆的峰雷狂熊身边，其中一个年轻人成员好奇对他问道。
峰雷狂熊刚回过神抬头看到是自己家兄弟就问道：“原来是小岩，对了你刚刚说什么了？”。
被峰雷狂熊叫小岩的年轻人，他看到自己团长没有听到自己刚刚的话就在一次问道：“团长，我刚刚说你为什么不留下颜铁龙呢？”。
“原来是这件事啊！嗨～，颜铁龙这家伙还是老样子，见到我就想跑，算了现在不要提他了。”峰雷狂熊听到小岩年轻人的话，对于自己无法招募颜铁龙感到失望道。
“对了，小岩吩咐大家，让每一个人准备一小包硫磺带在身上，这一次我们雇佣兵团一定要赶在其他雇佣兵团以及工会之前，收集大量紫水晶蜂蜜！”峰雷狂熊想起颜铁龙提醒就对叫小岩年轻人吩咐道。
被峰雷狂熊称之小岩的年轻人强然十分疑惑自己团长的要求，但是他很快执行自己团长交给他的任务道：“团长我知道了，我这就去办。”。
颜铁龙出了嚎叫酒馆，看到天色已经暗的街道，就向铂鹰旗南所说的夜火旅店方向走去。
当颜铁龙来到一处交叉路口，看到一名大概八岁左右小乞丐快速奔跑并跟欧斯派恩相撞撞
，欧斯派恩没有任何事，反而小乞丐被撞的摔倒到地。
欧斯派恩急忙上前扶着小乞丐关心问道：“小家伙，你有没有受伤？”。
“没，没事！”小乞丐说完起身有点慌张的跑向颜铁龙街道方向。
颜铁龙看到小乞丐向他跑过来，神情率有所思的，然后故意装作没看见被慌张的小乞丐撞到。
“小子你到底怎么一回事，走路都不长眼睛吗？”颜铁龙外表看上去愤怒样子对着倒地的小乞丐语气不善问道。
“对不起！”小乞丐起来急忙道歉道，然后快速绕过颜铁龙消失在街道。
“颜铁龙团长，他只是一个小孩子，你也不用这么恶劣对待他。”欧斯派恩听到颜铁龙语气不善对小乞丐就不满说道。
“我怎么对待那个小乞丐是我的事，你还是看一看自己的钱袋吧！”颜铁龙对欧斯派恩提醒道。

欧斯派恩听到颜铁龙就急忙摸向自己的钱袋，可是他的手没有碰到自己钱袋神情就变的严肃对颜铁龙问道：“难道刚刚那小乞丐是小偷？”。
“这是你的钱袋，看看你有没有少东西？”颜铁龙听到欧斯派恩的问题，他并没有回应反而直接将一个钱袋扔向欧斯派恩问道。
欧斯派恩接住钱袋，发现颜铁龙扔给自己的钱袋发现是自己，疑惑问道：“这到底是怎么一回事？”。
颜铁龙想也没想直接说道：“哦，刚刚我看到小家伙不经过你的同意拿走你的钱袋，我也没有经过他的同意，从他的身上拿走属于你的钱袋，就是这么简单。”。
当颜铁龙无所谓的样子经过欧斯派恩身边之时就听到欧斯派恩小声感谢道：“谢谢！”。
颜铁龙听到欧斯派恩的感谢，停下脚步转过身拍了拍欧斯派恩的肩膀提议道：“欧斯派恩天色这么晚了，我们一起回旅店这么样？”。
“乐意之至，颜铁龙团长。”欧斯派恩回应道。
在颜铁龙和欧斯派恩快到夜火旅店之时，突然从他们身后一处死胡同里传出充满痞子口气中年人声音：“混蛋！你一整天都没有任何收获了，居然还敢问我要钱，给我打，打到让他知道，这里谁才是老大。”。
颜铁龙听到后面小孩哭泣以及求饶声就停下脚步，转身快速跑向传出小孩哭泣声方。
欧斯派恩也听到哭泣声，同时注意到颜铁龙行动也跟上。
content_en:
Yan Tielong looked at the Fenglei Kuangxiong in front of him who insisted on joining their mercenary group. He didn't want this rude but good man to encounter an unexpected incident, so he asked again with certainty: "Fenglei Kuangxiong, do your mercenary group really want to do this high-risk mission?".
"Well, this is a rare opportunity. As long as we get one or two kilograms of amethyst honey before those mercenary groups, then the size of our mercenary group can be expanded. I don't plan to give up!" Fenglei Kuangxiong admitted that he would collect amethyst honey even in danger.
"Since you are going to collect amethyst honey, you members of the mercenary group had better bring some sulfur. Maybe it will save your life. By the way, don't touch the Poison Crystal Bee Queen. If you encounter it accidentally, run to the safe area as quickly as possible. These few points will be used as the money you paid to buy me this glass of ale." After Yan Tielong's kind reminder, he picked up the half-empty glass of ale and drank it in one gulp, then got up and left.
This time Yan Tielong left, and Fenglei Kuangxiong did not stop him. He was considering the information Yan Tielong had just provided.
"Captain, the one you just wanted to recruit was not Mr. Yan Tielong. Why did you let him go?" Several members of the Mountain Man Mercenary Corps passed by Yan Tielong. At that time, those members of the Man Mountain Mercenary Corps stopped and looked back at Yan Tielong's leaving figure. Then they quickly came to the Feng Lei Kuang Xiong who was in a daze. One of the young members asked him curiously.
As soon as Feng Lei Kuang Xiong came back to his senses, he looked up and saw that it was his brother and asked: "It turns out to be Xiaoyan, by the way, what did you just say?".
The young man who was called Xiaoyan by Fenglei Kuangxiong saw that his regiment leader did not hear what he just said and asked once: "Captain, I just said why don't you keep Yan Tielong?".
"So that's what happened! Hey~, Yan Tielong is still the same guy. He wants to run away when he sees me. Forget it, don't mention him now." Fenglei Kuangxiong heard what the young man Xiaoyan said and was disappointed that he couldn't recruit Yan Tielong.
"By the way, Xiaoyan asked everyone to prepare a small bag of sulfur to take with them. This time our mercenary group must collect a large amount of amethyst honey before other mercenary groups and trade unions!" Fenglei Kuangxiong remembered Yan Tielong's reminder and ordered the young man named Xiaoyan.
The young man who was called Xiaoyan by Fenglei Kuangxiong was very confused about the request of his captain, but he quickly carried out the task assigned to him by his captain and said: "Captain, I know, I will do it right away.".
Yan Tielong left the Howling Tavern and saw the darkened streets, so he walked towards the Night Fire Inn that Bo Ying Qinan had mentioned.
When Yan Tielong came to an intersection, he saw a little beggar about eight years old running fast and colliding with Ospine.
, nothing happened to Ospine, but the little beggar was hit and fell to the ground.
Ospine hurriedly stepped forward to support the little beggar and asked with concern: "Little guy, are you injured?".
"No, it's okay!" After saying this, the little beggar got up and ran towards Yan Tielong Street in a panic.
Yan Tielong saw the little beggar running towards him with a thoughtful expression, and then deliberately pretended not to see him being hit by the panicked little beggar.
"Boy, what's the matter with you? Don't you have eyes when you walk?" Yan Tielong looked angry and asked the little beggar who fell to the ground in a bad tone.
"I'm sorry!" The little beggar stood up and apologized hurriedly, then quickly walked around Yan Tielong and disappeared into the street.
"Captain Yan Tielong, he is just a child, you don't have to treat him so badly." Ospine said dissatisfied when he heard Yan Tielong's bad tone towards the little beggar.
"How I treat that little beggar is my business. You should take a look at your wallet!" Yan Tielong reminded Ospine.
When Ospine heard Yan Tielong, he hurriedly reached for his money.bag, but before his hand touched his money bag, his expression became serious and asked Yan Tielong: "Is that little beggar just now a thief?"
"This is your money bag, see if you have anything missing?" Yan Tielong heard Ospine's question. He did not respond but directly threw a money bag towards Ospine and asked.
Ospine caught the money bag and found that the bag Yan Tielong threw to him was him. He asked in confusion: "What on earth is going on?".
Yan Tielong said directly without thinking: "Oh, I just saw the little guy take your wallet without your consent. I also took your wallet from him without your consent. It's that simple."
When Yan Tielong passed by Ospine with a nonchalant look, he heard Ospine thank him in a low voice: "Thank you!".
Yan Tielong heard Ospine's thanks, stopped, turned around, patted Ospine's shoulder and suggested: "Ospine, it's getting so late, how about we go back to the hotel together?".
"With pleasure, Commander Yan Tielong." Ospine responded.
When Yan Tielong and Ospine were approaching the Night Fire Hotel, a middle-aged voice with a ruffian tone suddenly came from a dead end behind them: "Asshole! You haven't gained anything all day long, and you still dare to ask me for money. Beat me until you know who is the boss here."
Yan Tielong stopped when he heard the child crying and begging for mercy from behind, turned around and ran quickly towards the place where the child was crying.
Ospine also heard crying, and noticed that Yan Tielong was also following suit.
